title: Professional Email New Subscription Billing Standard
content:
**Billing standard.** A new Professional Email subscription is billed the seats times the product's seat price for the billing plan chosen: the annual-prepaid seat price times 12 for the annual prepaid plan, or one month at the annual-billed-monthly seat price or the month-to-month seat price for the first instalment or month. Only plans the product offers can be chosen, and the seats must lie between the product's fewest and most seats. Where the product applies the account discount, the seat price is reduced by the email discount percentage of the customer's account tier under Harborline Customer Accounts, and Microsoft 365 seats are never discounted. Amounts are rounded half up to the cent. A new subscription is billed when ordered, while it is provisioning.

## The three first charges

| Billing plan chosen | First charge |
|---|---|
| annual prepaid | seats times the annual-prepaid seat price times 12, reduced by the account discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent |
| annual billed monthly | seats times the annual-billed-monthly seat price, reduced by the account discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent |
| monthly | seats times the month-to-month seat price, reduced by the account discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent |

The account discount percentage is the email discount percentage of the customer's account tier where the product applies the account discount, and zero where it does not; the discount reduces the amount once, as 100 less that percentage, divided by 100. Each tier's seat prices, the plans each product offers and whether it applies the account discount are those of the product's price schedule.

## Timing and record

The charge is billed when the subscription is ordered, while its status is provisioning; the subscription record it belongs to is the one being ordered. The net amount billed on a subscription is the total of its subscription, instalment, renewal and seat charges less its refunds and seat-reduction credits.

## Worked examples (hypothetical prices, not a product's figures)

- 14 seats on the annual prepaid plan at a hypothetical seat price of 10.00 with a hypothetical account discount of 5 percent: 14 times 10.00 times 12 is 1680.00; reduced by 5 percent it is 1596.00.
- The same 14 seats on the monthly plan at a hypothetical 12.00 with no account discount: 168.00 for the first month.
